solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

definitions.meaning: a smoked herring cured whole, a kipper's cousin
something that puffs you out or inflates you, read literally as an agent noun

explanation.surface: A joke about a fish so rich it leaves the eater feeling puffed up.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsical second reading: a word for a cured herring also looks like 'one that bloats'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cured herring is a type of fish; the same word read as a coinage means a thing causing swelling.

parts.note: butter is spread on bread
Scotch is whisky from Scotland

explanation.surface: A sweet coated with a whisky mixture.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a hard, brittle kind of toffee made from brown sugar and butter.

clue.text: Exercise in muddy lagoon — it shouldn't be missed

indicators.note: in says the exercise letters are placed inside the other letters
muddy suggests the letters of lagoon are stirred up and confused

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: Someone attempting a workout in a murky lagoon, warned not to skip it.
explanation.definitionFit: In football, an undefended net is a chance any striker ought to score from, so missing it is embarrassing.

indicators.note: awful suggests the letters of what are put in a terrible mess

explanation.surface: An exclamation of disgust at a miserable day.
explanation.definitionFit: A rise in temperature that melts snow and ice is a type of weather.

clue.text: Engineers take forty days to ease off

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
Lent is the forty days of fasting before Easter

explanation.surface: Engineering staff taking a forty-day break to relax.
explanation.definitionFit: To soften one's stance or become less severe is to slacken, synonymous with easing off.

parts.note: to thresh grain is to beat it
rice is a grain

explanation.surface: A farm worker who has been separating the grain.
explanation.definitionFit: A female given name, so a woman, as Dante's beloved.

definitions.meaning: to intend is to have in mind as a purpose
an average is the arithmetic midpoint of a set of values

explanation.surface: Someone resolving to be ordinary.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb sense is to have a purpose in mind; the noun sense is the statistical middle value.

clue.text: Oxygen, for example, just a hint?

definitions.meaning: oxygen is one of the chemical substances in the periodic table
as in 'an ... of truth', a small trace of something

explanation.surface: A chemistry question asking whether oxygen is merely a faint trace.
explanation.definitionFit: Oxygen is an example of a chemical basic substance, and a trace or suggestion of something is likewise this word.

parts.note: reads as an invitation to vacation somewhere, but is the shop where trips are booked

explanation.surface: An invitation to spend a vacation at some resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'here' seems to be a destination; really it is the high-street office you visit to arrange the trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A business arranging trips and bookings is where people go to plan their vacations.

indicators.note: the letters of elation break apart and come out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone's intense joy bursts forth uncontrollably.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extreme' looks like an adjective qualifying elation, but with 'Person's' it is the definition: a part at a person's very extremity.
explanation.definitionFit: A nail on the foot sits at the body's furthest extremity, so it is a person's extreme part.

indicators.note: sounding says the word for rockier is to be heard rather than read as spelt

parts.note: rockier means more stony, comparative stonier

explanation.surface: A description of an eastern country with more rugged terrain.
explanation.walkthrough: Said in a non-rhotic British accent, 'stonier' ends with the same sound as the end of the Baltic country's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Baltic republic is a country, which is what land means here.

clue.text: Advantage of clipping front of boundary shrubs

indicators.note: clipping front of says the opening letter of the shrubs' word is trimmed away, as a gardener clips a hedge

parts.note: a hedge is a row of shrubs marking a boundary

explanation.surface: A gardener's benefit from trimming the hedge along the property line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clipping' suits hedges so well that it reads as gardening, but it signals removing the H.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the upper hand or a slight lead over a rival is having this; a synonym for advantage.

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of certain it are set out in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Someone finds it odd that a matter is surely complicated.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with many detailed interlocking parts is complicated; a direct synonym.

clue.text: One doctor picked up infestation on head of envoy, the idiot!

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

indicators.note: in a down clue picked up means the word for infestation is lifted, read bottom to top

parts.note: lice are a common infestation

indicators.note: head of means just the first letter of envoy is used

explanation.surface: A doctor catches lice from a diplomat and gets called a fool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' sounds like catching lice; in a down answer it reverses LICE to ECIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A foolish, stupid person is a fool or idiot; a direct synonym.

parts.note: a son is a boy

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting means the title word is raised, read upwards

parts.note: a name is a title

explanation.surface: A young man carrying off a championship belt.
explanation.definitionFit: When everyone acts together in complete agreement, they act unanimously, as a single person.

clue.text: Broccoli sample from rustic a lab re-sent

indicators.note: sample from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A laboratory sends back a sample of country-grown broccoli for testing.
explanation.definitionFit: Calabrese is the common green-headed variety of broccoli sold in shops, named after Calabria.

clue.text: Join up two points on catalogue

parts.note: E and N are two compass points, east and north
a list is a catalogue

explanation.surface: Instructions to connect two dots on a printed catalogue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two points' looks like a dot-to-dot puzzle but means two compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: To sign up for the armed forces is to join up; a phrasal synonym.

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a nag is an old or poor horse

explanation.surface: An instruction to lasso a pony.
explanation.definitionFit: A snag is a hidden drawback or problem, just as a catch is.

clue.text: Current is most important, I state

parts.note: top means foremost or most important
Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state

explanation.surface: Someone declares that what is happening now matters most.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' could be electrical or a stream, but here it means of present interest.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dealing with matters of present interest in the news is current, up to date.

definitions.meaning: a quick light kiss on the cheek
Gregory is the first name of the Hollywood actor of Roman Holiday

explanation.surface: Asking whether to kiss someone called Gregory.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief kiss is a quick one; Gregory, the film star, had this surname, hinted at by the question mark.

explanation.surface: A villain who keeps on being violent.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means proceed or carry on; as one word it is slang for a hired heavy.

parts.note: to iron is to smooth out creases
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: A suave chap who also happens to be very strong and athletic.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor in a gruelling swim-cycle-run triathlon event earns this title, implying great strength and endurance.

clue.text: Cuts roughly round extremely loose dog hairs

indicators.note: round means the cutting word goes around the letters that follow

parts.note: to hack is to cut roughly

indicators.note: extremely means only the extreme letters of loose are taken

explanation.surface: A groomer roughly trims a dog's untidy coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes L and E, the ends of loose, which sit inside HACKS.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the hairs along a dog's neck and back that rise when it is angry or alarmed.

clue.text: African party enters ten year rental agreement

indicators.note: enters means the party's letters go inside the others

parts.note: the ANC is the African National Congress, South Africa's governing party

explanation.surface: A political party signs a ten-year lease.
explanation.definitionFit: Occupying property under a lease, paying rent to a landlord, is this arrangement.
